subject: Status: retrieval ablations - the delta is real but small
body:
Hi Anders, Jelena,

Ablation results ahead of the July 3 milestone. With Rosa's rebuilt index serving retrievals, GPT2-XL with retrieved passages beats the no-retrieval baseline by +1.4 ROUGE-L on the KILT ELI5 validation split. Shuffled-retrieval control sits at +0.2, so the gain is from content, not just extra tokens - the model is using the retrievals, which is exactly the capacity question we set out to answer. Smaller-model replication (GPT2-medium) shows +0.3, consistent with the published finding that small LMs ignore retrieved text.

The honest caveat: +1.4 ROUGE-L is statistically solid but not a product headline. Where it gets interesting is factual consistency - in a 200-example manual audit, retrieval-conditioned generations had 31% fewer unsupported claims.

Risk: ELI5 answer quality is noisy to evaluate; ROUGE undercounts good paraphrases. Wei and I want to add a claim-verification eval for the August readout.

Quentin
